description: The instance requires authentication and this source has no access secret to offer: the recorded catalog response is a 401. The search fails with source_denied (-32001) and carries no detail at all, because anything specific enough to be useful about a refused request would confirm something the caller did not prove it may know. Health reports denied, and says only that no secret was configured here — a fact about this machine, which is the one thing an operator staring at a denied source needs and the one thing that reveals nothing about the source.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
